sections.Profile:
The "Wonderland" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in April 1955, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.The machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, one kick-out hole, and one gobble hole.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Fairy tale, Single Player, Wood Rail, Fantasy
